# Doxastic State

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DoxasticState>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/epistemics`](../../slices/epistemics.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent's intrinsic believing mode toward a proposition — the reified, first-class mental moment that grounds the flat doxastic spine ([`gmeow:believes`](../properties/gmeow-believes.md), [`gmeow:knowsThat`](../properties/gmeow-knowsThat.md)). A sibling of cognition:CognitiveState (knowing) and teleology:IntentionalMode (desiring/intending) under kernel:MentalMoment, so an agent's whole endurant mental life is queryable as one family ([Principle 15](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-15)). Inheres in exactly one agent via [`epistemicAgent`](../properties/gmeow-epistemicAgent.md) and is directed at exactly one [`Proposition`](gmeow-Proposition.md) via [`doxasticContent`](../properties/gmeow-doxasticContent.md); its qualitative belief value is carried by a linked [`StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) ([`doxasticClaim`](../properties/gmeow-doxasticClaim.md) → [`claimModality`](../properties/gmeow-claimModality.md)), and its graded strength by credence [0,1]. Never instantiated directly when the flat spine suffices ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:JustificationGround`](gmeow-JustificationGround.md), [`gmeow:JustificationSubject`](gmeow-JustificationSubject.md), [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:JustificationGround`](gmeow-JustificationGround.md), [`gmeow:JustificationSubject`](gmeow-JustificationSubject.md), [`gmeow:MentalMoment`](gmeow-MentalMoment.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Belief Revision

- **Source:** [`slices/core/epistemics/examples/belief-revision.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/epistemics/examples/belief-revision.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-belief-revision)#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-belief-revision

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/epistemics/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- Original belief (high credence, unequivocal) -----------------------------
ex:originalBelief a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "original belief: the printer is broken"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propPrinterBroken ;
    gmeow:credence "0.92"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:originalClaim .

# --- Revised belief (lower credence, probable) --------------------------------
ex:revisedBelief a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "revised belief: printer may be broken"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propPrinterBroken ;
    gmeow:credence "0.35"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:revisedClaim .
```

### Flagship Epistemic Ledger

- **Source:** [`slices/core/epistemics/examples/flagship-epistemic-ledger.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/epistemics/examples/flagship-epistemic-ledger.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-flagship-epistemic-ledger)#example-slices-core-epistemics-examples-flagship-epistemic-ledger

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/epistemics/flagship/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- Original credence-weighted belief (operator) --------------------------------
ex:opBeliefOriginal a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "original belief: LLM recalled the meeting date correctly"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propRecall ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:opClaimOriginal ;
    gmeow:credence "0.85"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:justifiedBy ex:evidenceSpan1 .

# --- Revised belief after a defeater ---------------------------------------------
ex:opBeliefRevised a gmeow:DoxasticState ;
    rdfs:label "revised belief: LLM probably misremembered the meeting date"@en ;
    gmeow:epistemicAgent ex:operator ;
    gmeow:doxasticContent ex:propRecall ;
    gmeow:doxasticClaim ex:opClaimRevised ;
    gmeow:credence "0.30"^^xsd:decimal .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when an agent's belief toward a proposition must be first-class — when credence, temporal scope (via [`DoxasticTenure`](gmeow-DoxasticTenure.md)), standpoint modality, or the mental moment itself needs to be queried or revised ([Principle 15](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-15)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the 80% case where an agent simply believes a proposition — use the flat [`gmeow:believes`](../properties/gmeow-believes.md) / [`gmeow:knowsThat`](../properties/gmeow-knowsThat.md) spine and carry modality on the statement layer; avoid double-typing a belief as both a flat relation and a [`DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md) for the same holding ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Mint one [`DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md) per (agent, proposition, claim-modality) tuple; link it via [`gmeow:doxasticClaim`](../properties/gmeow-doxasticClaim.md) to a [`StandpointClaim`](gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) whose vantage is the agent, [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md) is the proposition, and [`claimModality`](../properties/gmeow-claimModality.md) carries the qualitative value; attach credence for graded strength and a [`DoxasticTenure`](gmeow-DoxasticTenure.md) when belief revision history matters.

### Examples

- ex:aliceBelievesRound a [`gmeow:DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md); [`gmeow:epistemicAgent`](../properties/gmeow-epistemicAgent.md) ex:alice; [`gmeow:doxasticContent`](../properties/gmeow-doxasticContent.md) ex:earthIsRound; [`gmeow:doxasticClaim`](../properties/gmeow-doxasticClaim.md) ex:aliceRoundClaim; [`gmeow:credence`](../properties/gmeow-credence.md) "0.92"^^[xsd:decimal.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal.)
